planet.name: Ancient Greece
planet.summary: Ancient Greece is Next Island's linked time-travel area with its own map. Thebes is the market and quest hub. The headline unlock is the unlimited Falcata, and Thebes dailies pay Nots, dungeon key fragments and progress toward Islander status.
planet.howToReach: From Next Island, use the Orpheus' Cave teleporter and choose Ancient Greece in the destination dropdown (download the Ancient Greece map first).
warnings: Desk-checked from public sources only; in-game field verification is pending.
18.12.0 added Thebes, indoor mining and faction/VIP hunting dailies. 18.12.1 fixed a key-fragment mission and incorrect free VIP access, and disabled vehicles in the Catacombs.
Exact Nots task counts, vendor stock, cargo flags and timer triggers are unconfirmed.

activities.title: Travel to Ancient Greece via Orpheus' Cave
activities.summary: Download Ancient Greece, then use the Orpheus' Cave teleporter on Next Island and pick Ancient Greece in the destination dropdown (Medium or Large teleporter view). The cave teleporter is reported to be added when you enter.
steps: Download the Ancient Greece map in the client.
Go to the Orpheus' Cave teleporter on Next Island (waypoint below).
Switch the teleporter window to Medium or Large view and choose the destination from the dropdown.
Do not stockpile old time-travel crystals for this; the current route uses the teleporter interface.

score.rationale: Required to reach Ancient Greece; free and quick.

activities.title: Meeting the Gods → Falcata
activities.summary: On the Greek side, start Meeting the Gods, speak to Penthesilea twice before Creon, then do Talk with the Elder and Looking at Distant Pasts to earn the unlimited Falcata.
steps: Start Meeting the Gods.
Speak to Penthesilea twice (waypoint below).
Then speak to Creon (waypoint below).
Complete Talk with the Elder and Looking at Distant Pasts.

score.rationale: Top unlock in the recommended Greek route: a lasting weapon.

warnings: The source labels these waypoints 'Penthesilea Captain of the Amazon...' and 'Creon Archon of Thebes'; coordinates match.

activities.title: Becoming an Islander (Daily Islander Pursuit)
activities.summary: Pick up Becoming an Islander in Thebes if you plan longer visits. Each day you choose one of the offered hunting, mining, crafting, fishing, sweating or harvesting objectives. The August 2026 guide lists 137 completions for a reward bundle. The partner opened it to both offworlders and True Islanders.
steps: Start Becoming an Islander in Thebes.
Each day, choose one offered objective and complete it.
Turn in the selected daily in Thebes.
rewards: After 137 completions: reward bundle including the Islander Bumpercar and Giant L.A.R.A. Plushie
Islander status (needed for the Thebes SVIP)

cost.text: Depends on the objective chosen each day.

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; verify the reset trigger and choice limits in the journal.

score.rationale: Unlocks the long Islander track; flexible daily choice keeps cost low.

warnings: Daily reset trigger and choice limits unverified.

activities.title: Dungeon key fragments (Alexandra)
activities.summary: Alexandra in Thebes offers daily dungeon-key fragment missions, including an Asterion hunt and a mining assignment listed at 500 probes. Fragments are exchanged for a key at the Thebes terminal.
steps: Talk to Alexandra in Thebes and read the active description.
Do the hunt or mining assignment.
Exchange fragments for a key at the Thebes terminal only when you plan to run a dungeon.

cost.text: Ammo for the Asterion hunt, or 500 probes for the mining option.

currencies.name: Dungeon key fragment
currencies.note: Exchange for a dungeon key at the Thebes terminal.

score.rationale: Mid-game path into Thebes dungeons; mining option is probe-heavy.

warnings: 18.12.1 corrected the Asterion daily's description; read the active text before committing.

activities.title: Thebes 'Not a Token' dailies
activities.summary: In Thebes, speak to the NPC for the activity you already plan to do: Antonia (hunting), Nika (crafting), Alina (mining), Dora (harvesting) or Christa (fishing). They pay 'Not a Token' currency (Nots).
steps: Pick the Thebes NPC that matches your planned activity.
Complete the task and hand in.

cooldown.resetNote: Daily; live counts and cooldown trigger pending. NI Helper's generic 20 h for older dailies should not be assumed for newer Thebes missions.

score.rationale: Stacks with what you already do; Nots feed Thebes rewards.

warnings: Live task counts, payouts and cooldown triggers are pending.

activities.title: Spend Nots and key fragments
activities.summary: Nots and key fragments are separate Thebes resources. Save Nots for a chosen terminal reward, which can also need an extra item at full TT. Early buys like paintings and textures compete with saving for buff clothing or the Falcata-related exchange. Turn fragments into keys only when you intend to run a dungeon.
steps: Pick a terminal reward before spending Nots and check whether it needs an extra item.
Convert fragments only when you plan a dungeon run.

cost.text: Nots, sometimes plus an item at full TT.

score.rationale: Planning tip; avoids wasting Nots on early cosmetics.

warnings: Cargo classification and current vendor costs need live verification.

activities.title: Gorgon wave and Gorgonforged upgrades
activities.summary: For the older Gorgon wave, Deliver Us from the Dark Queen gates entry and you assemble a key before going to Knossos. The first Shade spawn needs crafting, mining and hunting hand-ins plus sweat; later spawns use sweat alone. 18.12.0 added a separate dungeon and key-fragment route and the Aegis of the Gorgonforged upgrade terminal.
steps: Complete Deliver Us from the Dark Queen.
Follow the key assembly guide before going to Knossos.
First Shade spawn: crafting, mining and hunting hand-ins with sweat. Later spawns: sweat only.
Read entry and upgrade costs at the Aegis of the Gorgonforged terminal before gearing up.

cost.text: Hand-in materials, sweat, key parts and combat spend.

score.rationale: Late, costly combat content; plan before gearing.

warnings: Read entry and upgrade costs before committing; vehicles were disabled in the Catacombs in 18.12.1.
